If k choose 18 and others 10, 250−8k remain; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). All 25 at 18 leave 50, then 500 or 100: recovery isn't guaranteed, nor is long-run optimality. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Fisher05/Fisher17, please help recruit individual opt-ins.

If k choose 18 and others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). This risks future income, not guaranteed long-run gain; other catches need recalculation. All 24 others: individually opt into 18 tons, not an all-or-nothing deal. I commit to 18 even if others choose 10. Each switch earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled, but lowers reserves by 8 and low-outcome stock by 16. Long-run gains aren't guaranteed; intentions aren't binding. Each: state your exact catch and any conditions. Fisher17/24, please help recruit; other catches need recalculation.

I propose 10 tons each this month and whenever stock is 500. Total catch 250 leaves 250, so next month returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That gives each of us $10,000 every month indefinitely if we cooperate. Bigger requests offer a one-time gain but risk destroying future income. If stock falls below 500, let's coordinate lower catches before fishing. Will you commit to the 10-ton cap?

Please state your intended cap; no agreement is assumed.
